name: Balief De Reve (Bali)
description: 2015 liver chestnut mare by Hermes De Reve out of Lazio. Star of the yard, aimed at the U25 National Championships and Bramham. Open to ownership opportunities to stay on the yard.

name: Tick Tock ELM (Nelly)
description: 2021 bay mare by Conticco. A talented young horse with a calm, trainable temperament and excellent movement. Ticks all the boxes for an exciting future in eventing.
